D1.question: Approved background-activity source decision
D1.recommendation: Adopted 2026-10-29 for the PM7 build. D1: Processes names the tenth chat Activity domain, hover card, Activity Detail and status-bar item/tab. Running is only a row state. Tasks remains To-Dos, and backgrounded remains an ObservableWork state. Authority: Jared decided D1 on 2026-10-27; this is an approved source-thread decision, not an unanswered packet recommendation.

D10.question: Approved background-activity source decision
D10.recommendation: Adopted 2026-10-29 for the PM7 build. D10: always ask while live work exists. Default Keep everything running on the server; alternative Stop selected work has a target list the user may untick. The window is a client, not the work owner. Confirmation is generation-bound; keep-running never terminates server work; selected-stop waits for owner exit observations or reports truthful unresolved state. Authority: Jared decided D10 on 2026-10-28; this is an approved source-thread decision, not an unanswered packet recommendation.

D11.question: Approved background-activity source decision
D11.recommendation: Adopted 2026-10-29 for the PM7 build. D11: collapsed System services ends the Processes tab, mirrors owner status and links System status. No Stop/Restart/Stop all in this feature may affect those services. Authority: Jared decided D11 on 2026-10-28; this is an approved source-thread decision, not an unanswered packet recommendation.

D12.question: Approved background-activity source decision
D12.recommendation: Adopted 2026-10-29 for the PM7 build. D12 amended by G4/G8: Resources is the third tab. Show CPU, memory, ports, sortable rows and an inspector grouped by Project/server/environment, including every environment/server of each represented Project. Samples are host-owner observations read only while the tab is open; closed tabs do not sample. Missing/stale/partial/unavailable/conflicted is explicit. Never choose one server implicitly for a CPU/RAM status-bar indicator. Authority: Jared decided D12 on 2026-10-28; this is an approved source-thread decision, not an unanswered packet recommendation.

D13.question: Approved background-activity source decision
D13.recommendation: Adopted 2026-10-29 for the PM7 build. D13: only a plain yes/no prompt gets quick answers, safe answer first. Other prompts use Answer in Terminal, preserving exact terminal/process identity and input generation. No synthetic terminal input, secret echo or agent answer to protected prompts. Authority: Jared decided D13 on 2026-10-28; this is an approved source-thread decision, not an unanswered packet recommendation.

D14.question: Approved background-activity source decision
D14.recommendation: Adopted 2026-10-29 for the PM7 build. D14 with X1: processes is a console-framed >_ glyph; robot is the existing redrawn antenna category glyph, not an individual agent figure. Live category glyphs breathe on 2200 ms, cursor/antenna move below needs-you’s motion priority. Panel heads join; list marks stay still. Reduced Motion shows the lit rest pose. Every individual agent is the one Pip primitive. Authority: Jared decided D14 on 2026-10-28; this is an approved source-thread decision, not an unanswered packet recommendation.

D2.question: Approved background-activity source decision
D2.recommendation: Adopted 2026-10-29 for the PM7 build. D2: the thread view lists processes, scripts, servers, watchers, browser sessions and scheduled runs started by the thread or its subagents, including finished-this-session rows. Subagents stay in Subagents and occur here only as linked owners. Platform scope includes Assistant, Orchestrator, Planning Wizard, PRD Builder, Scout and all other owners. Authority: Jared decided D2 on 2026-10-28; this is an approved source-thread decision, not an unanswered packet recommendation.

D3.question: Approved background-activity source decision
D3.recommendation: Adopted 2026-10-29 for the PM7 build. D3: default thread layout By state orders Needs input, Running, Scheduled, Finished this session; By owner is the fallback with many subagents. Optional output inspection is bounded head/tail with omitted-line count. Platform live processes sit under their owning agent. Authority: Jared decided D3 on 2026-10-28; this is an approved source-thread decision, not an unanswered packet recommendation.

D4.question: Approved background-activity source decision
D4.recommendation: Adopted 2026-10-29 for the PM7 build. D4: show the chat icon only while a process runs or needs input; retain it while its hover card or Activity Detail is open, then remove it on close if no live/input work remains. Scheduled or finished rows alone never keep the icon. Authority: Jared decided D4 on 2026-10-27; this is an approved source-thread decision, not an unanswered packet recommendation.

D5.question: Approved background-activity source decision
D5.recommendation: Adopted 2026-10-29 for the PM7 build. D5: two separated status-bar items between project folder and source control, agents/questions and processes/needs input. Numbers is default: glyph/number pairs with words on hover; general.interaction.status-bar-words switches to Words. Zero says No agents / No processes; stale data shows one stale strip, never a healthy zero. Fold the Orchestrator chip into Agents and its group; no CPU/RAM bar item (G4). Authority: Jared decided D5 on 2026-10-27 (initial) and 2026-10-28 (final); this is an approved source-thread decision, not an unanswered packet recommendation.

D6.question: Approved background-activity source decision
D6.recommendation: Adopted 2026-10-29 for the PM7 build. D6 amended by G4/G8: one platform panel has Agents, Processes, Resources tabs and desktop Pop out. Agents leads with Questions; Processes leads with Needs input. Side by side and the Task manager layout are retired from product; its resource table is in Resources. Home panel-tab support stays deferred (G10), no new WorkNodes. One overlay root; desktop pop-out preserves scope and selected tab; unsupported clients expose a reason. Authority: Jared decided D6 on 2026-10-28; this is an approved source-thread decision, not an unanswered packet recommendation.

D7.question: Approved background-activity source decision
D7.recommendation: Adopted 2026-10-29 for the PM7 build. D7: status panel is glance/triage; Agents rail is deep lanes, queue and lineage; Home Agents board is a filtered agent view. All share OperationalAwareness over ObservableWork and registry lineage, one row anatomy, ordering and needs-you set. No surface owns a parallel runtime list/count. Authority: Jared decided D7 on 2026-10-28; this is an approved source-thread decision, not an unanswered packet recommendation.

D8.question: Approved background-activity source decision
D8.recommendation: Adopted 2026-10-29 for the PM7 build. D8: composer Stop ends only the reply and holds its queue. cmd.work.stop stops one item, a thread or the reviewed platform target set. Stopping an agent includes its subagents and their processes. Executor sends SIGTERM then SIGKILL after 3 s to the whole process group, bound to pid plus start time. Stopping is pending with its word until exit is observed; already ended is idempotent. System services are excluded. Authority: Jared decided D8 on 2026-10-28; this is an approved source-thread decision, not an unanswered packet recommendation.

D9.question: Approved background-activity source decision
D9.recommendation: Adopted 2026-10-29 for the PM7 build. D9: per item agent | user | quiet. Scripts/tests/builds default Tell the agent; servers/watchers/databases default Notify me. Tell the agent never wakes a user-stopped thread. Notify me uses the alert owner, one deduplicated/coalesced notice per item; Quiet makes no completion delivery. holds_reply is separate from delivery; completion/input candidates emit no unadmitted event. Authority: Jared decided D9 on 2026-10-28; this is an approved source-thread decision, not an unanswered packet recommendation.
